content: A probabilistic context-free grammar (PCFG) consists of a grammar INLINEFORM0 and rule probabilities INLINEFORM1 such that INLINEFORM2 is the probability of the rule INLINEFORM3 . Letting INLINEFORM4 be the set of all parse trees of INLINEFORM5 , a PCFG defines a probability distribution over INLINEFORM6 via INLINEFORM7 where INLINEFORM8 is the set of rules used in the derivation of INLINEFORM9 . It also defines a distribution over string of terminals INLINEFORM10 via
